zh-Hans: 快捷窗口支持全键盘流（Tab 切目录、Space 预览、回车打开）、新动态一键直达，并在设置中提供自动定位与自动置顶开关
支持文件动态冻结与原位返回、worktree 标识、菜单栏拖拽入中转、7 天闲置中转清理及 Ghostty 等终端自动识别
全面优化主窗口/快捷窗口列表流畅度与 SQLite 索引连接复用、语句缓存及目录快照内存缓存
en: Keyboard-first Quick Panel with Tab switching, Space Quick Look, one-click fresh activity jump, and opt-in auto-focus & auto-pin settings
Added timeline freeze & scroll restore, worktree badges, menu bar drag-to-Transit, stale Transit cleanup, and automatic terminal detection including Ghostty
Improved list rendering smoothness and SQLite indexing throughput with persistent connection reuse, prepared statement caching, and in-memory directory snapshots
